subject: general
question: Which country successfully test fired Zircon hypersonic cruise missile in November 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Russia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Russia successfully test-fired a hypersonic Zircon cruise missile over a distance of about **1,000 km (625 miles)**, the defence ministry said on Saturday.
 
• **The Tsirkon hypersonic system was salvo-launched on December 24, 2021,** and again launched **on February 19, 2022.**
 
• Russia's hypersonic missile Zircon was fired from the Admiral Gorshkov frigate stationed in the Barents Sea and “successfully hit” a target stationed **1,000 km** away in the White Sea

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Russia first tested the Zircon in **January 2020** from the Russian Northern Fleet's Admiral Gorshkov, claiming it can reach speeds of up to **Mach 9 (6,600 mph).**
 
• Zircon is intended to arm Russian cruisers, frigates and submarines and could be used against both enemy ships and ground targets.
 
• Zircon had reached a speed of **Mach 8** (6,100 mph; 9,800 km/h; 2,700 m/s) during a flight test.
